actual_service_probes.scope: HTTP gateway and TLS local HTTPS backend; real FRP TCP/UDP data. Isolated loopback backends; no operator network NAT assertion.

reproduction.components: At the recorded verifier source, run verify-nestlink-components.yml or scripts/verify-homedesk-components.py --signatures with gh and cosign. Download each actual public Release, hash all bytes, check tag revisions, SHA256SUMS, corresponding-source.zip, BUILD.json and its GitHub OIDC Sigstore identity. Compare with components-13.0.0.json.
reproduction.site: Serve docs/site on loopback. Execute the embedded site script with Chromium/Playwright 1.58.2, NESTLINK_SITE_ORIGIN and NESTLINK_SITE_SOURCE set to this recorded commit. Adapt only the local Playwright module/output paths. It checks eight pages in both themes at widths 320/390/768/1440, responsive menu focus, normal scrolling with hidden bars, original image loading, exact static downloads and hashes without JavaScript, and loading/offline/error fallbacks. The website files are hashed above.
reproduction.lifecycle: After the accepted native/browser/Android integration, revoke the independently credentialed background device using /api/v2/auth/devices/{id}. Probe the same HTTP, HTTPS local-backend, FRP TCP and UDP services and require each to stop. Foreground-revocation continuity is recorded in the component acceptance.

scope: Automated and reproducible integration on the actual released Server, Client and Android bytes. Native media used installed Linux x64 X11 desktops and Android x86_64 emulator; Windows/ARM64 exact-package installation/startup/credential tests are separate from media. Browser JPEG maximum 1920x1080, approximately 6.7 fps. No physical Android, operator NAT or sustained media assertion. Windows has no Authenticode publisher signature. No production deployment upgrade.
